mapper.select: SELECT o.event_id FROM tb_outbox o JOIN tb_seckill_request r ON o.request_id=r.request_id JOIN tb_activity_control c ON c.voucher_id=r.voucher_id WHERE c.state='NORMAL' AND c.epoch=r.epoch AND r.phase='ACCEPTED' AND ((o.state='PENDING' AND o.next_at_ms<=#{now}) OR (o.state='CLAIMED' AND o.lease_until_ms<=#{now})) ORDER BY o.next_at_ms LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_outbox SET state='CLAIMED',claim_token=#{token},lease_until_ms=#{leaseUntil},attempts=attempts+1 WHERE event_id=#{id} AND ((state='PENDING' AND next_at_ms<=#{now}) OR (state='CLAIMED' AND lease_until_ms<=#{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT request_id,attempts FROM tb_outbox WHERE event_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_outbox SET state=#{state},last_result=#{result},next_at_ms=#{next},claim_token=NULL WHERE event_id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token} AND state='CLAIMED'
mapper.select: SELECT state FROM tb_outbox WHERE request_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_outbox SET state=IF(attempts>=#{maxAttempts},'QUARANTINED','PENDING'),next_at_ms=#{now},claim_token=NULL WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='SENT'
